# Atomic Realm Post-Apocalyptic World — free selection

- Source: https://atomicrealm.itch.io/post-apocalyptic-world
- Author: Atomic Realm (https://atomicrealm.itch.io/)
- Downloaded: 2026-09-08
- Imported formats: Unity-rotated FBX models and their PNG textures
- Imported content: Starter, Gas Station, Into The Wild, Pharmacy, Interiors
- Original archives: `Build/ThirdPartyStaging/AtomicRealmPostApocalyptic`

The source page permits use and modification in commercial and non-commercial
projects. It forbids repackaging, resale, and redistribution of the assets, and
requires attribution to Atomic Realm with this link:

https://atomicrealm.itch.io/

The original license images and readme files are retained in `Documentation/`.
Do not distribute the source FBX or texture files as a standalone asset pack.

## Repository setup

The repository is public. Raw models, textures and other asset payloads are
therefore excluded from Git. Only this documentation, license notices and Unity
import metadata are versioned. Download the free packs from the source page and
copy the selected files into the paths described by the existing `.meta` files;
preserve those metadata files so authored scene references keep their GUIDs.
The tutorial cover requires `Starter/Models/wall_concrete_metal.fbx` and
`Starter/Models/post-apocalyptic_texture.png`. A source checkout without this
local import is not a complete Unity build environment (the MEP and terrain
packs are also installed separately).
